HIIT pushes your aerobic engine, helping you get fitter, recover faster and feel less gassed in hard fast efforts. 4.	Improve endurance and work capacity.   The repeated intervals teach your body to handle intensity better.  Over time consistency builds and you can play with the variables of recovery.  The benefits carries over to other sport, training and everyday energy. 5.	Time-efficient and low-impact.   You get a brutal session in a short window and the rower is easier on the joints which has been a an absolute game changer.
